name: Quay sticky rice
summary: Xôi is sticky rice, sold late afternoon on the Ninh Kiều quay as xôi bắp with corn, xôi đậu phộng with peanuts, and plain xôi trắng. Eat it on the spot or on a park bench, with barbecue, bánh xèo, bread, and sweet potato from the same stalls.
howToEat: Eat it on the spot, or on a bench in the park, between about 16:00 and 19:00.
where: The road to Bến Ninh Kiều.
seoTitle: Xoi on the Ninh Kieu quay
seoDescription: Xôi bắp, xôi đậu phộng, and xôi trắng on the Ninh Kiều quay from about 16:00 to 19:00.
